title: Autonomous bulk-property investigation of diamond germanium
difficulty_reasons: The system and observables are fixed, but the Agent must choose and discriminate computational models independently.
Joint convergence, band-edge identity and elastic-response validation are required.

paper.title: An Accurate Alternative to Hybrid Functionals for Germanium: DFT+α
paper.journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C

data.description: Closed JSON specification of neutral two-atom diamond Ge and measurement boundaries.

required_deliverables.description: Machine-readable model investigation, validation, observables, comparison, conclusion and limitations.
Optional detailed convergence and fit diagnostics referenced by results.json.
